bio.text: Aisha Wahab represents California's 14th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives; she was sworn in on September 2, 2026, filling the seat vacated by Eric Swalwell, after winning an August 2026 special election, according to NBC Bay Area and Ballotpedia.
She was elected to the Hayward City Council in 2018, became mayor pro tempore in 2020, and served in the California State Senate.
She holds a B.A. in political science from San Jose State University, an MBA from CSU East Bay, and a doctorate from the University of Southern California.
She was born in New York City and lives in Hayward, California.

sources.title: Aisha Wahab sworn into Congress to fill Eric Swalwell's seat
